verdict.rationale: Quo has a substantial public API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec and versioning policy. Documented endpoints cover calls, call summaries, and a full webhooks API. Nothing claims or shows that the API matches the UI, and many UI features have no documented API equivalent, including phone menus, ring orders, number setup, and Sona configuration. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API coverage of UI admin features (phone menus, custom ring orders, call transfers, number provisioning, Sona setup, AI call tags), independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Quo API enables developers to integrate powerful communication features directly into their applications and workflows.
